definition.description:
Denoise Volume

Smooths a stack with a gaussian and stores the result on the same grid.
definition.name: Denoise

definition.description:
Detect Spikes

Finds threshold crossings and stores them as a trace of the same length.
definition.name: Detect Spikes

args.description: Peaks above this count, in mV

definition.description:
Greet

Says hello. The docstring's first line is the action's title, the rest its
description — this is the whole UI, generated from the signature.
definition.name: Greet

definition.description:
Write Demo Tiff

Writes a small synthetic two-cell field to disk and returns its path, so the
other actions have something to read without a download.
definition.name: Write Demo Tiff

definition.description:
Read Tiff

Reads a TIFF with tifffile. The array stays on this agent.
definition.name: Read Tiff

returns.description: A numpy array held by this agent

definition.description:
Segment

Otsu-thresholds a smoothed copy and labels the connected components.
definition.name: Segment

args.description: A numpy array held by this agent

returns.description: A numpy array held by this agent

definition.description:
Count Objects

How many labels the mask carries, background excluded.
definition.name: Count Objects

args.description: A numpy array held by this agent

definition.description:
Measure Nuclei

Segments scikit-image's `human_mitosis` field by Otsu thresholding and
reports what the connected components add up to.
definition.name: Measure Nuclei

args.description: Objects smaller than this are noise

returns.description: What a segmented field of nuclei amounts to.

definition.description:
Move To

Drives the stage there in 20 steps and returns the distance travelled.
definition.name: Move To

definition.description:
List Images

The TIFFs in this installation's image directory.
definition.name: List Images

definition.description:
Physical Size

The width of an image in micrometers, using this installation's pixel size.
definition.name: Physical Size

definition.description:
Count Cells

Reads the image and counts the objects in it. Changes nothing, so if its agent
dies, it is simply run again (AT_LEAST_ONCE) unless the caller says otherwise.
definition.name: Count Cells

definition.description:
Segment

Stores a new label dataset next to the image. No claim (UNKNOWN), and honestly
so: a re-run stores a *second* dataset. By default a lost run fails; a caller
who'd rather clean up a duplicate than lose the run asks for AT_LEAST_ONCE.
definition.name: Segment

definition.description:
Load Plate

Records a new plate on the deck. Any guard on the old plate now fails.
definition.name: Load Plate

definition.description:
Dispense

Moves liquid into a well. Running it again puts twice the volume in the well.
definition.name: Dispense

definition.description:
Read Absorbance

Reads the plate reader. Moves nothing, so it overrides the app's default.
definition.name: Read Absorbance

definition.description:
Stain And Measure

Counts the cells in the well's image, doses dye in proportion, then reads the well.
definition.name: Stain And Measure
